summary: The proposed patch adds a new attribute `refit_time_` to `BaseSearchCV`, which measures the time taken to refit the best model on the full dataset after hyperparameter optimization.

issues.description: The patch does not handle the case where `n_jobs != 1`. When using multiple jobs, the timing should account for the parallel execution of fits.
Adding timing logic within the `fit` method may introduce subtle behavioral changes, such as affecting the reproducibility of the results due to timing-related randomness.
